returns.title: Exchange and return policy
returns.noBags: Bags cannot be exchanged or returned.
returns.originalCondition: The product must be in its original condition.

policy.intro: Customers may request an exchange or return within 14 days of delivery under the following conditions:
policy.cond1: The item is in its original condition as received.
policy.cond2: The item has not been used, damaged or soiled.
policy.cond3: The original box and all accessories are included.
policy.cond4: The original invoice or order number is provided.
policy.excludedTitle: Cases not covered by exchange or return
policy.excluded1: Items that were used or damaged after delivery.
policy.excluded2: Items that are not in their original condition.
policy.excluded3: Items modified or repaired by the customer.
policy.excluded4: Items showing any signs of use or poor storage.
policy.onlineText: For items ordered online and received from the courier, the customer may request an exchange or return within 14 days of delivery under the conditions above.
policy.customerChangeTitle: If the customer changes the size or made a wrong choice
policy.customerChange1: If the exchange or return is due to choosing an unsuitable size.
policy.customerChange2: Or a change of mind after delivery.
policy.customerChange3: Or wanting a different colour or model.
policy.customerChange4: The customer bears the full shipping cost of the exchange or return, both ways.
policy.storeErrorTitle: If the store made a mistake
policy.storeError1: A different size than ordered was sent.
policy.storeError2: A different product than ordered was sent.
policy.storeError3: A confirmed manufacturing defect in the product.
policy.storeError4: The store bears all shipping, exchange and return costs in full.
policy.inspection1: All returned items are inspected before an exchange or return is approved.
policy.inspection2: The store reserves the right to decline a request if the item does not meet the exchange and return conditions.
policy.refund1: The order value is refunded after the item is received, inspected and the return is approved.
policy.refund2: Refunds can take several working days depending on the payment method used.
policy.note1: We recommend checking the size chart and contacting customer service before ordering to make sure you pick the right size.
policy.note2: A slight colour difference caused by lighting or your phone or computer screen settings is not considered a defect.
policy.note3: Completing a purchase means you agree to the store's exchange and return policy.
policy.title: Exchanges and returns
policy.footer: This section sets out the store's approved exchange and return conditions, so the process is clear and both the customer's and the store's rights are protected.
policy.durationText: Exchanges or returns can be requested within {{days}} days of delivery.
